title: Momentum Strategies
one_line: Both past returns and past earnings surprises predict stock returns over the next 6-12 months, and each has power beyond the other; much of the drift clusters around later earnings announcements — consistent with slow reaction to information.

findings.statement: Price and earnings momentum each predict 6-12 month returns; little reversal afterwards.

reported_results.headline: Both past returns and past earnings surprises predict stock returns over the next 6-12 months, and each has power beyond the other; much of the drift clusters around later earnings announcements — consistent with slow reaction to information.
